items.title: What Is Uber Technologies (UBER) Gaining From Its Expanded 14 Market Delivery Tie Up?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and McDonald’s agreed a multi-year expansion of their delivery and loyalty partnership across 14 global markets. Under the new agreement, Uber becomes the preferred integrated delivery provider for McDonald’s app orders in key international countries. The deal links Uber’s and McDonald’s loyalty programs, giving customers new cross-reward earning and redemption options. items.title: Uber Becomes McDonald’s “Preferred Delivery Partner” in 14 Markets as Its DoorDash Fight Widens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMcDonald’s named Uber the preferred delivery partner for orders placed in its own app, as part of a multi-year expansion across 14 markets for a McDelivery business that brings in more than $20 billion a year. The deal comes days after another big-brand delivery deal, so Uber has now signed two of the biggest consumer brands while DoorDash works through its deal to buy Instacart.
